outcome: Cardiovascular pathology requiring medication or intervention
cohort: Participants were all cases with fetal isolated ventricular size disproportion diagnosed between 2002 and 2015 from a prenatal congenital heart defects regional registry.
finding: The postnatal course of cases with fetal ventricular size disproportion (without aortic coarctation) is complicated by prenatally undetected congenital defects (46%) and pulmonary or transition problems (35%) in a significant number of cases.
